name: JUGGUN
description: A Hip-fire focused Modification Kit for the Stoner 96 LMG. R&D specifically clarified that the ergonomics were going to be completely different from what you have already experienced and, as compensation, fitted your weapon with an even bigger magazine, though....the budget wouldn't allow for said increase to reflect on ammunition reserves. Become War and Draw First Blood....or do like the Town Mouse and live for nothing.
